name: driftRL
description: A Reinforcement Learning-based system that automatically handles data drift in datasets by removing missing, duplicate, and invalid data blocks dynamically.
highlights: Built a custom RL environment to detect and clean data drift.
Used Docker for containerization and reproducible execution.
Achieved dynamic preprocessing and cleaning of datasets.

name: Machine Log Monitor
description: A full-stack machine monitoring system built with Spring Boot, REST APIs, and a modern frontend dashboard to track system health and resolve error logs efficiently.
highlights: Developed a robust backend in Spring Boot to process system health logs.
Designed REST API endpoints to feed real-time monitoring data to the dashboard.
Provided an interactive UI for administrators to track and resolve error logs.

name: Tour Booking Manager
description: A console-based software applying core Object-Oriented programming concepts in C++ to manage user selection, reservations, payments, and receipt file generation.
highlights: Utilized C++ Object-Oriented principles (Inheritance, Polymorphism, Encapsulation) for clean architecture.
Implemented file read/write systems for reservation persistence and receipt printing.
Designed an intuitive console menu flow for customer billing and ticket management.
